g.text: C23 RC reader grace: metadata lifetime and fatal custody
no context pointee access after failure; metadata grace still required
strong phase only; normal return discharges slot access
address-only record; fatal does not unwind gate normally
escaped/unknown hook cannot issue normal completion
all old readers drained, not merely claim DONE
same-gate scan grace; independent of failed metadata lookup
DONE precedes mark_reachable_from_marked; no phase grace yet
all admitted lookups, claims and descendants must finish
live coordinator issues combined metadata grace; root/origin duties remain
